note: Seven RV spots beside the only motel in Nevis, on Highway 34 about 12 miles east of Park Rapids, a short walk to downtown and Halvorson Beach. The operator mentions large lots with room for bigger campers. Staff on site. --Claude
summary: Operator site read: 7 full-hookup RV spots (amps not stated), $35/night April-October, 'No winter camping' (derived year_round replaced), booked by phone. Google 4.7 from 45 reviews; price gate passes; not long-stay in character. Not waterfront kept. Pin is ~170 m east of the motel, on a storage-building lot.
flags: Private gate facts: posted rate $35 a night (crowwinginnrv.com/rates, read 2026-11-11; under US$50, no gateway needed). Presence: operator site with phone (218) 652-3600, 'Hours 8:00am — 8:00pm 7 Days a week'. Google Maps 4.7 from 45 reviews (the motel-and-RV-park listing, 117 MN-34). Not a Good Sam Park claim on the operator's pages. RV Life rating stored 4*/$$.
Long-stay tests: only a nightly rate is posted; no weekly, monthly or seasonal rates, no residents mentioned, no wording discouraging nightly guests. Passes.

Season: stored year_round true (derived) contradicted: 'April – October $35 Per night' and 'No winter camping.' (only the motel rooms are 'Welcome Year-Round'). Written as 04-01 to 10-31 with the operator's wording in the season note.
OHV mention (not a staging park): 'You may park your ATV or UTV right outside the inn for fast access to Nevis's thrilling trails!' The park is a motel's RV spots in town, not an ATV trail base.

Facilities: stored showers and laundry (derived from note prose) and sites.pull_through are not stated on the operator's pages ('large lots and room for the bigger campers, call for more details'); left as they were, unconfirmed.

Pin: stored 46.96360,-94.83730 sits on a lot of long storage buildings ~170 m east of the motel. Google's pin for the business is the motel at 46.96285,-94.83924. The RV spots are not identifiable on the (leaf-off) imagery; a dirt loop among trees just north-east of the motel (about 46.9634,-94.8387) may be them. Suggest moving the pin to the motel, 46.96285,-94.83924.
Note: stored text repeated fields (hookups, facilities, year-round) and said 'Open year-round', which the operator contradicts for the RV spots; rewritten.
